name: Python API
tagline: FastAPI + Uvicorn service starter for automations and data APIs — pytest and Ruff gates included.

scaffold.title: Create the service from the blueprint
scaffold.detail: Copy the file tree in stacks/fastapi-service/blueprint.md into a new repository — app package, tests and gates included.

scaffold.title: Install dependencies
scaffold.detail: Use a fresh virtualenv and a locked install so versions match the manifest.

scaffold.title: Configure the environment
scaffold.detail: Copy the example env file and fill in local values. Never commit secrets.

scaffold.title: Run the dev server
scaffold.detail: Pick a free port — the Control Plane itself uses 3014.

scaffold.title: Keep the gates green
scaffold.detail: Every change passes unit tests, lint and the container build before it ships.

scaffold.title: Ship to an approved node
scaffold.detail: Register the app in BYOV and deploy the container only to admin-approved targets. First supported kind: self-hosted Coolify.

starter.note: Versioned starter repos and one-command scaffolding arrive with the BYOV client.
